title: Five executive orders given to the president
summary: Steven Greer tells of Five executive orders given to the president, about 2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So that's what I'm trying to get the president through these five executive orders. Here they are one page.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who has long argued that the truth about UFOs is being kept secret, told the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that he was trying to get the US president to sign five executive orders, which are direct orders a president can issue without Congress. Greer says each order fits on one page, and he describes the effort as his own work. If it went the way he hopes, the president would force secret UFO knowledge into the open.
